context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 75: Five major features added and verified. (1) Razorpay Payment: Admin configures credentials via dashboard, stored in MongoDB system_meta. create-order returns 503 if not configured, 500 if invalid credentials. (2) Offline QR Payment: UPI QR code generated via qrcode library, users upload payment proof screenshots. (3) Admin Payment Management: Pending verifications list with approve/reject, auto-reactivates suspended users. (4) Native WebRTC Live Help: WebSocket at /api/ws/livehelp/{session_id}, 5 Google STUN servers, text chat + voice toggle, session logging with rule-based troubleshooting, auto-ticket generation for bugs. (5) Admin Dashboard now has 10 tabs including 'Payments'. F&O Dashboard has 6 sub-tabs including 'Alert Rules'. LiveHelp FAB (data-testid='livehelp-fab') opens chat panel (data-testid='livehelp-panel'). Note: Test Razorpay credentials are invalid so create-order returns 500 - this is expected.
